newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Guatemala army on watch for Honduran escapees.
newsitem.headline: Guatemala army on watch for Honduran escapees.

text.p: Guatemalan army units in armored vehicles were patrolling the Honduran border on Friday on the lookout for dozens of prisoners who escaped this week in prison riots in the neighboring country.
"The army is carrying out patrols because of the prison escape in Honduras," army spokeswoman Edith Vargas said in a news release.
More than 200 prisoners were still at large after close to 500 escaped on Monday during a riot in the jail in Santa Barbara, Honduras, 75 miles (120 km) from the Guatemalan border.
Monday's riot touched off a series of uprisings in overcrowded jails in Honduras. Three jails were torched by inmates, and two prisoners were shot to death by guards putting down one of the revolts.
